sector_timing_note: First forward crossings of equal Track.path sectors; TUM XY projected sequentially onto Track.path and its periodic clock rotated to the same timing line. Reference is a different QSS model, not an attainable-time guarantee.
geometry_margin_note: Clearance measured at recorded 50 Hz actual poses; strict original environment checked containment every 2 ms. No claim this is the minimum intersample clearance.

factor_scaling_heuristic.note: Arithmetic illustration only: the 0.70 global speed target explains most of the deliberately slow baseline; it is not a physical lap prediction.
